examName: Food Safety Officer, Food and Drug Administration, Group-B
examNameMr: अन्न सुरक्षा अधिकारी, अन्न आणि औषध प्रशासन, गट-ब
examPattern: Written Examination / Screening Test followed by Document Verification or Interview

papers.paperTitle: Food Safety Officer, Food and Drug Administration, Group-B
papers.paperTitleMr: अन्न सुरक्षा अधिकारी, अन्न आणि औषध प्रशासन, गट-ब

topics: Periodic Table/ Concepts of qualitative Analysis
Bonding & structure of organic compound & their nomenclature
Mechanism of organic Reactions Alkanels & Cycloalkanes
Chemical calculations - Introduction to Molecular Spectroscopy
Aromatic Hydrocarbons - Haloarenes, Phenols, Ether and Epoxides
Source of organic compounds chemical industry
Carbohydrates, Proteins, Fats, Fibers, Vitamins, Minerals, ME etc
Effect of food processing on food nutrition
Food Adulteration (Common adulterants, simple tests for detection of adulteration)
Food Additives (Classification, Functional role, Safety issues)
Food Packaging & labelling (Packaging types, Understanding labelling rules & Regulations, Nutritional labelling, Labeling requirements for pre-packaged food as per CODEX)

units.unitTitle: Introduction of Food Processing and Technology
topics: F&VP, Milk, Meat, Oil, Grain milling, Tea-Coffee, Spices & Condiments processing
Food processing techniques (Minimal processing technologies, Photochemical processes, Pulsed electric field, Hurdle technology)
Food Preservation Techniques (Pickling, Drying, Smoking, Curing, Canning, Bottling, Jellying, Modified atmosphere, Pasteurization etc.)
Standards. Codex of practice, Guidelines and Recommendations
Codex India – Role of Codex Contact point, National Codex Contact Point (NCCP)
National Codex Committee of India – TOR (Terms of Reference), Functions, Shadow Committees etc
Identifying organic foods, Advantages, The Organic Certification Process, Organic food labeling
Why are GM food produced. Main issues of concern for Human Health, How are GM Food regulated Internationally, Regulation in India
Role of WHO to improve evaluation of GM food
How is food Irradiated, Sources of radiations used
Functional foods from plant sources, Animal sources
What is Nanotechnology, use in food products and processing

units.unitTitle: Advances in Food Safety & Quality Management
units.unitTitleMr: अन्न सुरक्षा आणि गुणवत्ता व्यवस्थापनातील प्रगती
topics: Objective, Scope & Use, Key aspects of Hygiene Control Systems etc.
What is GMP, GMP in Food Industry etc.
What does ISO 22000 bring to the HACCP Method
Quality Manual, Mandatory Procedures, SOP’s, Formats and Records etc.
